translated_title: Denying the Blockade Against Cuba Is US Hypocrisy, Cuban Ambassador to Mexico Eugenio Martínez Says
original_title: Negar el bloqueo contra Cuba es una hipocresía de EU, afirma embajador Eugenio Martínez
author: Fernando Camacho and Enrique Méndez
meta_description: At Mexico's Chamber of Deputies, the diplomat said Washington imposes an energy siege, virtually a naval blockade, and pressures countries to change their UN votes.
